jobs.title: Director, Risk and Performance Technology
jobs.description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. Located in downtown Toronto, our vision is to be the partner of choice for Ontario’s public sector funds and to build a high-performing, value-driven asset management firm.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.

If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

‎

As IMCO continues to evolve its Target Operating Model, the importance of timely, trusted, and actionable risk and performance insights continues to grow. Technology plays a critical role in enabling investment decision-making, performance measurement, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, and enterprise risk oversight.

If you are looking to lead a strategic technology portfolio and help shape the future of Risk and Performance capabilities at IMCO, we would love to hear from you.

We are looking for a highly motivated Director, Risk & Performance Technology.

Reporting to the Vice President, Investment Technology, the Director, Risk & Performance Technology is accountable for the strategy, delivery, operation, and evolution of IMCO's Risk and Performance technology capabilities.

This role provides technology leadership for the applications, analytical platforms, reporting capabilities, and integrations that support Risk and Performance. The Director will establish the roadmap for the Risk and Performance technology portfolio, lead key technology initiatives, and ensure technology capabilities remain scalable, reliable, and aligned with IMCO's future operating model.

The role partners closely with Risk, Performance, Investment Operations, Data & AI Enablement, Enterprise Technology, and Front Office stakeholders to improve analytical capabilities, enhance reporting and measurement processes, and deliver trusted insights across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Business Partnership

Define and execute the multi-year technology roadmap for Risk and Performance capabilities, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IMCO's Target Operating Model.
Serve as a trusted technology advisor to leaders across Risk and Performance.
Partner with business stakeholders to identify future capability needs, technology opportunities, and process improvement initiatives.
Contribute to Investment Technology planning activities and support the development of long-term technology strategies across the investment ecosystem.
Support business case development, vendor evaluations, and technology investment decisions related to Risk and Performance platforms.

Risk & Performance Solution Delivery

Lead the delivery and enhancement of technology solutions supporting portfolio risk measurement, factor analytics, exposure analysis, performance measurement, attribution, benchmark management, and investment reporting.
Oversee the design, implementation, integration, and support of business-critical applications and analytical platforms.
Ensure solutions are designed to support scalability, automation, operational efficiency, and future business growth.
Partner with Architecture, Data Platform & AI Engineering, Enterprise Technology, and Cyber Security teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and target architectures.
Promote effective delivery practices and ensure technology solutions are implemented in a disciplined and sustainable manner.

Application Portfolio Ownership

Provide overall ownership and oversight of Risk and Performance technology platforms and application portfolios.
Establish application roadmaps, lifecycle management plans, and support strategies that align with business objectives.
Lead application upgrades, enhancements, integrations, modernization initiatives, and platform rationalization activities.
Evaluate emerging vendor solutions and analytical capabilities to support evolving business requirements.
Manage strategic relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and service providers.

Data, Analytics & Reporting Enablement

Partner with the Data Platform & AI Engineering team and business stakeholders to ensure Risk and Performance solutions leverage trusted, governed, and reconciled investment data.
Support the development and consumption of analytical data products, calculation engines, and reporting-ready datasets.
Drive improvements in measurement processes, reporting workflows, calculation transparency, and analytical consistency.
Promote the adoption of common data standards and integrated analytical capabilities across investment teams.
Enable modern analytics, reporting, and decision-support capabilities that improve investment insight and business outcomes.

Governance & Operational Excellence

Ensure Risk and Performance technology solutions operate in accordance with IMCO policies, architecture standards, security requirements, and governance frameworks.
Establish operational processes that support stable, secure, and sustainable application services.
Oversee incident, problem, change, release, and service management activities across the portfolio.
Support audits, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and control testing activities.
Ensure appropriate documentation, training materials, support procedures, and operational controls are maintained.

People Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing team of business analysts, application specialists, technical leads, and technology professionals.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Coach, mentor, and develop team members to support career growth and organizational capability development.
Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans aligned with business and technology goals.

What you need to succeed:

12+ years of progressive experience delivering and supporting investment technology solutions within asset management, investment management, or financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading technology teams supporting Risk, Performance, Analytics, or related investment functions.
Strong understanding of portfolio risk management, performance measurement and attribution, benchmark management, investment reporting, and portfolio analytics.
Experience developing technology roadmaps and delivering complex application and platform initiatives.
Strong knowledge of investment data, analytical platforms, reporting solutions, and application integration patterns.
Experience managing software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers.
Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
Strong understanding of application lifecycle management, service management, governance, and operational support practices.
Excellent communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Experience with industry-leading Risk and Performance platforms such as MSCI RiskManager, BarraOne, Axioma, FactSet, Bloomberg PORT, Eagle Performance, or similar solutions is highly desirable.
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, or a related field. Advanced education and professional certifications are considered an asset.

‎

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Our hybrid work model prioritizes an office-first approach, encouraging employees to make the most of our collaborative workspace at 16 York Street, Suite 2400, Toronto, ON M5J 0E6. This welcoming environment fosters teamwork, connection, and professional growth. While flexibility remains a key component of our model, we believe that regular in-office engagement enhances productivity and strengthens our culture. Our approach supports a fulfilling lifestyle that balances professional ambition with personal wellbeing.

IMCO is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to support parts of our recruitment process, such as screening and assessments. However, all hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team. Candidates being considered for this position will be required to undergo background screening.

jobs.title: Director, Investment & Digital Enablement
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As a Director, Investment & Digital Enablement, you will be a strategic voice on the Savings, Investments and Advice team. You will support defining the business intent and outcomes, author business cases, groom roadmaps and initiative-level direction for some of our most complex, highest-impact client journeys, working 1–3 quarters ahead to ensure squads always have a business-justified pipeline to execute against. You will regularly extend your expertise across multiple squads, partnering and advising stakeholders and Sr. Executives, while mentoring emerging talent across the team.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed

Own the business case and roadmap for high-impact initiatives — Lead the development of the squad-level roadmap, business cases and benefit forecasts for highly visible initiatives in the Saving, Investments & Advice domain, ensuring every initiative entering the backlog is grounded in a clear, quantifiable business rationale.
Lead discovery and business direction — Author and facilitate discovery with your Product Owner & stakeholders, establishing the business direction, journey context and initiative framing that sets the direction for requirements and overall squad success.
Author epics that set squads up to win — Defining business objectives, success metrics and scope before a single story is written. Hold the quality bar for Epics across the team.
Be the senior business voice with stakeholders — Act as the interface between your squads and senior business stakeholders, translating progress into compelling business narratives and representing the squad wherever investment and prioritization decisions are made.
Own benefit realization — Define KPIs and success metrics at the outset of every initiative, and partner with measurement and analytics teams post-launch to track performance against the original business case.
Extend your expertise across squads — Provide advisory support to multiple squads, bringing consistency and best practice to business execution planning throughout.
Mentor and elevate team talent — Coach junior and intermediate members of the Investment & Digital Enablement team and contribute directly to team standards, tools and ways of working.

Who You Are

You can demonstrate experience. 10+ years of experience in leading large, cross-functional, complex initiatives, business analysis, client/product strategy, or a closely related discipline, ideally within financial services or another regulated environment. You have a proven track record of owning Epics, business cases, or equivalent initiative-level artifacts, and translating them into roadmaps that Product Owners and squads can execute against.
You can demonstrate knowledge. You bring working knowledge of agile delivery — Jira, Epics and Stories, story-writing standards and INVEST principles — and apply it fluently across a multi-squad environment.
You are a strategic storyteller and influencer. You are able to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into a clear narrative and business case that earns buy-in from Product Owners, technology partners and senior executives alike.
You are a systems thinker with commercial instinct. You connect client needs, business objectives and platform capability, and know how to sequence work so today's results sets up tomorrow's opportunity.
You are a credible communicator. You are able to effectively communicate with senior business stakeholders, capable of building and defending a business case at the executive level.
You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can hold a long view of the roadmap 1–3 quarters ahead, while still bringing the discipline to translate strategy into a well-scoped, buildable Epic.
You are a trusted advisor. You build credibility through the quality of your thinking and the consistency of your judgment rather than a reporting line, and you use that credibility to guide Product Owners and shape team standards. You have experience mentoring or informally guiding colleagues. This role does not carry formal people-management accountability, but team-level mentorship is core to the mandate.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

Description

The opportunity

Aspire Software, an operating group of Valsoft Corporation, acquires, builds, and grows vertical market software companies around the world. Each brand operates with entrepreneurial autonomy while benefiting from shared expertise, leadership, and collaboration across our global portfolio.

Aspire Software is launching a new AI-driven B2B SaaS venture and is seeking an AI Lead to build and lead it from day one. We partner with vertical market software businesses to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can unlock significant customer value. This new venture will focus on building a developer-first, AI-enabled SaaS platform, designed to integrate seamlessly into existing workflows and scale through strong product adoption.

The market opportunity is proven, fragmented, and ready for transformation. As AI Lead, you will shape the product vision, drive go-to-market execution, build the founding team, and establish market leadership - backed by Aspire and Valsoft’s capital, infrastructure, and global operating expertise.

What You'll Be Doing 

Lead a new B2B SaaS business built around AI and platform innovation in a vertical software market 
Develop and execute a scalable go-to-market strategy: identify early adopters, iterate on positioning, and close first customers 
Define product and market strategy, with a strong focus on developer experience, adoption, and scalability
Build a milestone-based plan, allocate budget, and raise capital with our support 
Assemble a high-performing team to execute across product, tech, sales, and operations 
Partner closely with technical leaders to ensure high-quality APIs, SDKs, documentation, and integration workflows
Own and operate the business with full autonomy  

What You Bring 

A founder mindset: You’re motivated by building from scratch and fully owning the journey 
3+ years of experience building or operating AI software, API or SDK based platforms with leadership experience (e.g. Product lead, Startup Founder, or Sales/Operations lead) 
Demonstrated success in building early-stage ventures or leading 0→1 product launches, with bachelor in relevant field  
Strong understanding of developer-first products, including documentation, onboarding, reliability, and versioning
Grit and resourcefulness with proven success of operating without a playbook  
Commercial mindset with exposure to pricing, packaging, GTM execution, and customer adoption
Excellent communication skills across technical and business domains
Ability to drive the overall company vision, culture, and performance 

What You’ll Own 

P&L responsibility: You’ll run the company day-to-day and long-term 
Equity stake: You’ll be a significant shareholder in the business you help create 
Product and market vision: You’ll lead strategy, execution, and team alignment 
Customer outcomes: You’ll focus relentlessly on value creation for users 

How To Apply  

Interested? Send your resume and a brief note about why you're excited about this opportunity. We'd love to see:  

Your track record building or scaling businesses  
Examples of go-to-market strategies you've developed and executed  
Anything that demonstrates your ability to build from scratch and drive results 

About Valsoft 

Established in Canada in 2015, Valsoft Corporation acquires, operates, and scales vertical market software companies around the world. Through our AI Ventures program, we’re building a new generation of AI-native businesses designed to transform specific industries. Each venture operates as an independent startup — with speed, ownership, and autonomy, backed by Valsoft’s global infrastructure and capital.

L'opportunité

Chaque marque bénéficie d'une autonomie entrepreneuriale tout en profitant de l'expertise, du leadership et de la collaboration partagés au sein de notre portefeuille mondial.

Aspire Software lance une nouvelle plateforme SaaS B2B basée sur l'IA et recherche un Responsable IA pour la développer et la piloter dès son lancement. jobs.description:
Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers

The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets. United as a global team, we’re connecting cross-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.

Ready to be part of the action?

The Managing Director, Digital Finance
serves as the senior finance leader accountable for leading the strategic transformation of Finance operations across systems, data, reporting, business processes, and artificial intelligence. In this business leadership capacity, you will establish priorities, set governance standards, and ensure sustained adoption and measurable value creation. Operating as the primary business counterpart to Technology and working in close partnership with the Chief Financial Officer and senior leadership, you will oversee the strategic roadmap to replace manual, fragmented workflows with a trusted, single source of financial data and insight that accelerates enterprise decision-making and supports global growth.

Reports to:
Chief Strategy and Innovation Officer

Job Location:
Hybrid (2–3 days/week in office) – based in Toronto, ON.

Key Accountabilities

Finance Transformation & Portfolio Delivery

Own and champion the multi-year Digital Finance roadmap and unified backlog across the CFO organization, prioritizing initiatives by business value, control requirements, readiness, effort, and operational cost in close collaboration with Technology.
Sponsor and drive end-to-end process redesign across record-to-report, plan-to-perform, procure-to-pay, and order-to-cash workflows to modernize core operations.
Establish robust business cases for all digital initiatives, tracking adoption metrics, cycle-time reductions, redeployed capacity, and internal control enhancements.
Authorize the decommissioning of legacy reports, spreadsheets, and manual steps following the rigorous validation of modern digital replacements.

Finance Systems & Core Architecture

Act as the accountable Finance business owner for Workday Financials and Workday Adaptive Planning in collaboration with Controllership and FP&A process owners, establishing high standards for clean data capture, straight-through processing, chart-of-accounts governance, and audit-ready planning workflows.
Ensure Workday configurations align with enterprise best practices, spearheading the design and ongoing governance of the Foundation Data Model (FDM) to support scalable accounting, reporting, and analytics requirements.
Partner with Technology, external implementation specialists, and Workday to conduct recurring architecture reviews and remediate configuration gaps.
Oversee and approve the business roadmap for the broader finance application ecosystem (close management, consolidations, billing, accounts payable, expense management, treasury, and tax), actively identifying rationalization opportunities.
Align application release schedules with the financial close calendar, collaborating with Technology, Risk, and Internal Audit to enforce rigorous segregation of duties, access controls, and Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR).

Finance Data, BI & Analytics

Direct the team responsible for designing, building, and operating finance data models, data pipelines, and certified financial data products on Snowflake, establishing a single source of truth across all global entities.
Establish robust semantic layer governance, ensuring every certified data product possesses an assigned Finance owner, approved definitions, and ongoing reconciliation to general ledger accounting outputs.
Oversee Finance’s enterprise Business Intelligence (BI) capabilities and visualization standards, transitioning teams from static reporting to dynamic, interactive dashboards and executive decision environments utilizing tools such as Amazon QuickSight and native cloud analytics capabilities.
Accelerate data-driven insights across Finance by collaborating with Finance Business Partners and operational data teams to integrate financial and operational drivers, including trading, clearing, listings, and market data subscriptions.

Applied AI & Intelligent Automation

Identify, prioritize, and oversee the rollout of high-impact finance AI use cases—such as variance analysis, exception triage, predictive forecasting, narrative document synthesis, and anomaly detection—ensuring each deployment maintains clear quality thresholds, human-in-the-loop oversight, and independent model validation.
Drive end-to-end automation of data collation, reconciliation, and distribution throughout the reporting cycle while safeguarding professional financial judgment and formal authorization checkpoints.

Market Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Monitor evolving capabilities across Workday, Snowflake, business intelligence ecosystems, and emerging financial technologies, assessing business viability and integrating high-value opportunities into the strategic roadmap.
Provide strategic advisory to the Finance Senior Leadership Team on emerging technology trends, fostering shared ownership of digital adoption.

People Leadership & Change Enablement

Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning finance systems, data engineering, business intelligence, and advanced analytics, establishing clear strategic direction while scaling functional capacity.
Drive enterprise change management, communication, and training programs to embed digital literacy and analytical curiosity across the broader finance organization.
Manage the Digital Finance operational budget, serving as the business partner to Technology and Procurement for vendor selection and delivery partner management.

Must Have(s)

12+ years of progressive finance experience with comprehensive knowledge of core accounting and financial processes, coupled with advanced financial analysis capabilities.
Professional accounting or financial credential (CPA preferred; MBA or CFA will also be considered).
Demonstrated success serving as the business lead for major finance transformations (e.g., enterprise ERP implementations, EPM/planning platforms, or enterprise data and reporting overhauls) from conception through operational adoption and value realization.
Proven leadership experience guiding data, BI, or analytics personnel, underpinned by sufficient technical literacy in data modeling, SQL, cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), and modern BI suites to establish standards and guide technical execution.
Deep knowledge of financial governance frameworks, internal controls, and ICFR requirements within large-scale system and process transformation environments.
Demonstrated track record managing multi-year business cases, departmental budgets, third-party software vendors, and systems integration partners.
Proven leadership acumen in ambiguous, matrixed environments with strong cross-functional stakeholder management and executive presentation skills.

Nice to Have(s)

Experience with Workday Financials and Workday Adaptive Planning, including Foundation Data Model (FDM) architecture and data integration with Snowflake.
Direct technical experience with data querying and scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python).
Practical experience deploying artificial intelligence or machine learning solutions within corporate finance environments, including model validation and risk management frameworks.
Industry experience within capital markets, financial services, financial technology, or software organizations.
Leadership background within multi-entity, multi-currency, and multinational operating structures.
Experience building, structuring, and scaling a digital or transformation function from early-stage maturity.

jobs.description:
Overview

Director, Digital & Information Management is a leadership role responsible for developing and implementing the digital strategy and information management framework for one of our major new build projects. The role is responsible for developing and implementing the digital strategy and information management framework for this project. The Director reports functionally to the Vice-President, Digital Solutions and operationally to the Project Director.

This Director ensures that all project data, documentation, and digital systems are integrated, secure, and aligned with company standards, regulatory requirements, industry standards, and project objectives. The position drives digital transformation to enable efficient collaboration, lifecycle data management, and regulatory compliance across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning phases.

Key responsibilities include leading project teams, developing work execution plans, recruiting and assigning team members, managing project deliverables, organizational structure, budget, schedule, risk management, and overseeing people forecasting and levelling for the project.

Your role

Lead the development and execution of the Digital and Information Management strategy for a large-scale nuclear new build project.
Align digital initiatives with project objectives, corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and long-term asset lifecycle management.
Champion digital transformation through BIM, digital twins, data analytics, advanced collaboration platforms, and emerging technologies.
Establish and govern enterprise-wide information management frameworks, including data governance, metadata standards, and document control processes.
Ensure compliance with nuclear industry regulations, cybersecurity standards, and industry best practices such as ISO 19650 and IEC 62645.
Implement and manage integrated digital systems, including BIM, EDMS, project controls, scheduling, cost management, ERP, and asset information platforms.
Lead the deployment of Common Data Environments (CDE) and Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) solutions across EPCM partners, suppliers, and stakeholders.
Oversee project-wide BIM execution, ensuring cross-disciplinary integration, interoperability, data quality, and a single source of truth for project information.
Establish robust cybersecurity, digital safety, training, and corrective action programs to protect critical systems and ensure regulatory compliance.
Monitor digital performance, drive stakeholder adoption, report on system effectiveness and data integrity, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement and cost optimization.

About You

Minimum 10 years of leadership experience in digital transformation, information management, or IT management within large infrastructure, engineering, energy, or industrial projects.
Strong expertise with BIM, Common Data Environments (CDE), Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), and project controls platforms.
Experience with integrated 3D engineering design technologies such as Hexagon SmartPlant/Smart 3D, AVEVA, or comparable plant design systems.
Knowledge of nuclear new build projects, reactor design, construction execution, and nuclear industry operating practices is preferred.
Proven ability to lead teams, manage direct reports, and support project delivery organizations through complex digital initiatives.
Solid understanding of Advanced Work Packaging (AWP), engineering, procurement, and construction workflows within large capital projects.
Familiarity with ISO 19650 information management standards, cybersecurity frameworks, and nuclear regulatory compliance requirements.

Façonnez l’avenir des ventes de Vortex en Amérique du Nord

Vortex Structures Aquatiques International est un chef de file mondial dans la conception et la fabrication de solutions innovantes de jeux aquatiques. Depuis 1995, nous créons des expériences mémorables qui rassemblent les communautés grâce à des environnements aquatiques de classe mondiale installés partout dans le monde.

Relevant directement du Vice-président exécutif et membre clé de l’équipe de direction, la personne titulaire du poste définira et exécutera la stratégie de ventes nord-américaine, accélérera la pénétration des marchés, renforcera la performance de nos partenaires de distribution et assurera l’excellence de notre structure de pôles régionaux. Elle dirigera une organisation performante tout en favorisant une forte collaboration entre les différentes fonctions de l’entreprise.

Ce que vous ferez

Stratégie commerciale et croissance

Développer et exécuter la stratégie de ventes et commerciale nord-américaine en cohérence avec les objectifs de croissance de Vortex.
Stimuler la croissance des revenus, des parts de marché, de la rentabilité et de la fidélisation de la clientèle.
Identifier les nouvelles occasions de marché, tendances clients et partenariats stratégiques.
Diriger la planification des ventes, la budgétisation, les prévisions et la gestion de la performance.

Leadership régional et développement des ventes

Diriger et développer les directeurs régionaux des ventes et assurer la performance des différents territoires.
Élaborer des plans d’action régionaux fondés sur l’intelligence de marché, les besoins des clients et les occasions de croissance.
Bâtir, accompagner et inspirer une organisation de ventes hautement performante axée sur la responsabilisation, la collaboration et l’amélioration continue.
Développer les talents et promouvoir une culture de vente consultative et de relations fondées sur un rôle de conseiller de confiance.

Clients et partenaires de distribution

Renforcer les relations avec les clients clés, comptes stratégiques, consultants, municipalités, promoteurs et partenaires de distribution.
Développer des stratégies visant à accroître la couverture du marché et la performance de nos partenaires.
Soutenir les occasions d’affaires majeures et les négociations stratégiques.
Promouvoir une approche centrée sur le client à chaque étape de son expérience avec Vortex.

Collaboration et excellence opérationnelle

Collaborer étroitement avec les Solutions clients, le Marketing, la Conception de projets, les Services techniques, les Opérations, la Fabrication et le Développement de produits.
Assurer une gestion rigoureuse du pipeline, des prévisions, du CRM et des indicateurs de performance.
Diriger la stratégie de prix, les politiques commerciales et les programmes de rémunération incitative.
Exploiter les données et l’intelligence d’affaires afin d’améliorer la prise de décision, la productivité et la rentabilité.

Ce que vous apportez

Plus de 15 ans d’expérience progressive en leadership des ventes, incluant des postes de haute direction commerciale.
Succès démontré dans la direction d’organisations de ventes multirégionales et l’atteinte d’une croissance soutenue.
Expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier, des produits d’ingénierie, de la construction, des loisirs, des infrastructures ou dans un environnement B2B complexe.
Expérience dans la gestion d’équipes de vente directe et de réseaux de partenaires de distribution.
Solides compétences en leadership, coaching, planification stratégique, développement des affaires, négociation et gestion des relations.
Solide sens des affaires et acuité financière, notamment en matière de prévisions, de prix et de rentabilité.
Maîtrise des systèmes CRM et de l’analyse des ventes.
Baccalauréat en administration, commerce, marketing ou domaine connexe; MBA considéré comme un atout.
Bilinguisme français et anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
Disponibilité à voyager en Amérique du Nord et à l’international, au besoin.

Vous aurez l’occasion de contribuer à façonner l’avenir d’une marque mondiale reconnue tout en dirigeant une organisation commerciale talentueuse dans une importante phase de croissance. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d’une équipe de direction passionnée qui valorise l’innovation, la collaboration et la création d’expériences clients exceptionnelles.

Shape the Future of North American Sales at Vortex

Vortex Aquatic Structures International is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of innovative aquatic play solutions. Since 1995, we have been creating memorable experiences that bring communities together through world-class aquatic environments installed around the globe.

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary Vice President, Sales & Commercial Strategy
to lead our North American commercial organization and drive Vortex's next phase of sustainable and profitable growth.

Reporting directly to the Executive Vice President and serving as a key member of the Executive Leadership Team, this role will define and execute Vortex's North American sales strategy, accelerate market penetration, strengthen channel partner performance, and ensure excellence across our Regional Hub structure. The Vice President will lead a high-performing commercial organization while fostering strong collaboration across the business.

What You'll Do

Commercial Strategy & Growth

Develop and execute Vortex's North American sales and commercial strategy aligned with the company's growth objectives.
Drive revenue growth, market share, profitability, and customer retention.
Identify emerging market opportunities, customer trends, and strategic partnerships.
Lead sales planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Lead and develop Regional Sales Directors and drive performance across territories.
Develop regional action plans based on market intelligence, customer needs, and growth opportunities.
Build, coach, and inspire a high-performing sales organization focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Develop talent and promote a culture of consultative selling and trusted-advisor relationships.

Customer & Channel Excellence

Strengthen relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, consultants, municipalities, developers, and channel partners.
Develop strategies to enhance market coverage and channel partner performance.
Support major opportunities and strategic negotiations.
Champion a customer-centric approach throughout the Vortex customer experience.

Collaboration & Operational Excellence

Partner closely with Customer Solutions, Marketing, Project Design, Technical Services, Operations, Manufacturing, and Product Development.
Ensure discipline in pipeline management, forecasting, CRM utilization, and performance metrics.
Lead pricing strategy, commercial policies, and incentive programs.
Leverage data and business intelligence to improve decision-making, productivity, and profitability.

What You Bring

15+ years of progressive sales leadership experience, including senior commercial leadership roles.
Proven success leading multi-region sales organizations and delivering sustained growth.
Experience within manufacturing, engineered products, construction, recreation, infrastructure, or a complex B2B environment.
Experience managing both direct sales teams and channel partner networks.
Strong leadership, coaching, strategic planning, business development, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Strong financial and business acumen, including forecasting, pricing, and profitability management.
Proficiency with CRM systems and sales analytics.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field; MBA considered an asset.
Bilingual in English and French, both written and spoken.
Ability and willingness to travel throughout North America and internationally as required.

You'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of a respected global brand while leading a talented commercial organization through an important phase of growth.
